You're right to be annoyed, Cody. You ordered 20 TH/s in July and neither unit has moved.

The 20 TH/s I can get you today is two Hammer Thor P2s, 10 TH/s each, on the shelf and shipping within 2 business days. You paid $499 for your two; those two are $758, so $259 apart.

I'm not asking you to cover that after this wait, so I've put it to Abel and Georges to waive the difference. They're in at 10am ET and it comes to your email. If they clear it, I do the swap here.

Noted, Cody, your yes is on the record: both lines to two Thor P2s, 20 TH/s, nothing for you to pay.

I won't run it with $259 hanging on it, because that would just invoice you and hold the box again. The waiver sits with Abel and Georges, they're in at 10am ET, and the answer goes to your email. The second it's cleared I do the swap here and the units go out within 2 business days.

Nothing else needed from you.
